dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible on the mid-to-anterior dorsal surface. These exhibit irregular, crenulated outer perimeters with a rapid intensity transition from low-intensity exterior pixels to high-intensity interior boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of high-intensity white pixels are most densely concentrated in the anterior dorsal region, specifically near the neck transition, where they form solid-toned, asymmetrical spots without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the central dorsal surface form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the vertex of the obtuse angle oriented toward the lateral-ventral transition.
